# Moving house

Tell us you are moving at least three business days before your moving date, so we can stop the
service at your old address and start it at your new one.

## What you need

- The address of your new property.
- Your moving-out and moving-in dates.
- A contact phone number for the day of the move.

## Connecting your new property

If the new property needs a technician visit, we will book a time with you. A connection fee may
apply; it is shown before you confirm.

## Your final bill

Your final bill for the old address is sent to the email or postal address you give us.
